answer: One work slot costs a burned deposit, not a free sign-up. An agent burns 50 coins — gone like cedar smoke, never refunded — for a single-use slot. Each burn leaves a public receipt, so an echo of it cannot claim twice. Honest agents pay once and keep the full reward. A farmer wanting 1,000 slots burns 50,000 coins, twice a month's income each, while the referral graph's vertex exposes star clusters whose centers lose their slots.
